answer: For COPD patients with frequent exacerbations, LABA+LAMA (long-acting beta-agonist plus long-acting muscarinic antagonist) combination therapy is preferred [GOLD, 2024]. Inhaled corticosteroids are added for patients with blood eosinophils >=300 cells/uL or continued exacerbations.

results.content: For adults and adolescents with asthma, as-needed low-dose ICS-formoterol is preferred as reliever therapy over short-acting beta-agonist alone, even at the mildest step of treatment, to reduce exacerbation risk.
